propositions: Operator-attested describes evidence location, not actor identity; agents may record truthful concrete observed evidence without requiring human authorship
The [operator-attested] criterion tag must be added to checkbox text before plan review to avoid invalidating the signed plan-material fingerprint
Comments are non-material and may be added after plan certification without changing the material digest or stale-material verdict

Late addition of the [operator-attested] tag after plan signing edits description text, triggering material-diff invalidation and stale-material rejection by the close gate before completion verification runs

The plan-writing guide must explicitly teach the classify-before-review-and-comment-afterward ordering to prevent the design conflict between early material-pinning anti-tamper intent and post-delivery remediation guidance
Existing safeguards for exact-tag matching, concrete-specificity validation, and command-versus-attestation distinction must be preserved in ADR 0043 and implementation
